svg.text: Density sorts planets into composition families — and the gap between two of them is the sharpest
A radius alone is ambiguous: a 2 R⊕ planet can be a dense rock of 10 M⊕
or a 3 M⊕ core wrapped in 1% hydrogen. Only the MASS separates them —
and even then, water and hydrogen mixtures stay degenerate.
envelope entirely or not at all — and because 1% of
hydrogen by MASS is ~40% of the RADIUS, there is
nothing in between. The gap is the escape physics.
